title: SUTD Undergraduate Merit Scholarship
official_source: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)
program_type: Merit-based tuition scholarship for new undergraduate admission applicants
duration: Up to four years (the normal duration of the relevant SUTD bachelor degree programme)
description: The SUTD Undergraduate Merit Scholarship is an academic merit award for applicants to SUTD bachelor's degree programmes. It pays the subsidised tuition fees, after the Tuition Grant, for the normal duration of the programme, up to four years. It carries no bond, but the recipient must take up the Singapore Government's Tuition Grant Scheme to enjoy subsidised fees. Recipients must maintain good academic standing, reviewed every term, and complete at least 20 hours of service to the University. Applications are made as part of the SUTD admission application.

description: The SUTD Trailblazers Scholarship is a leadership-and-merit award for applicants to SUTD bachelor's degree programmes, described by SUTD as one that 'empowers high-performing students who exhibit outstanding potential to lead and make an impact'.
